source.summary: GitHub Actions 'Embedder footprint' runs for the #365 change (branch fix/365-eq-face-identity at head c503a078207d086dd9d2d2c6407aabc7ef6ff292 — the #365 change (plain type exports mint an (eq) face in the type index space, confined to validation identity, with every consumer resolving the (eq) generic to the type it denotes) on top of its base fcc577f, merged with current main 2d653bfae0bd3ac995c17a0d26154f531762d28c (PRs #379, #382 and #383) for footprint attribution; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45813419836, 45813435144 and 45813449727 against the branch produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for the #365 change (plain type exports mint an (eq) face identity), following the merge of current main at 2d653bf (PRs #379, #382, #383) into the branch. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45812192789, 45812208358 and 45812224165 on main at 2d653bfae0bd3ac995c17a0d26154f531762d28c; all three runs pass the gate). This change's own delta against the main control is confined to the three configurations that link telomere-component: in release, stripped file +4,448 B (component) and +4,432 B (wasi, wasi-threads) and stripped .text +4,128 B on all three; in release-size, stripped file +3,120 B and stripped .text +2,704 B on all three. Every other series is byte-identical to main in both profiles. Against the checked-in baseline only the three release stripped file series grow (component +2,568 B, wasi +2,552 B, wasi-threads +2,568 B; the release .text series and every release-size series measure below their retained baselines), so only those three series are re-baselined to the branch measurements and every other baseline is retained, following the established practice of re-baselining growth only. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +11.53% (2,433,656 B to 2,714,216 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
